role: Exploratory development on previously inspected routes; no held-out superiority claim
status: Candidate definitions fixed before candidate outcome inspection
shared: Reuse saved learning and probe images, saved weights, spiking parameters, memory and controller from the 440-trial study. Re-run both references and demand exact trajectories and steering scores. Only named input operations change.
primary_descriptive_endpoint: Whole-trajectory mean route deviation including failures; equally average routes and seeds.
inference: Report paired route/seed effects and crossed bootstrap uncertainty. Any p-values are exploratory, sign-flip tests on eight route means conditional on these five seeds, Holm across five candidates per comparator. No result-guided parameter search or extra candidates in this matrix.
stop: Complete all 280 trials regardless of rankings. Do not promote a new default automatically. New worlds and independently fixed evaluation are needed to validate a candidate.

candidates.unit_dc: Divide only the third form plane by its Gaussian kernel sum.
candidates.balanced_form: Equalise pooled form-plane RMS with floor 0.05 times shared form RMS; retain normal downstream standardisation.
candidates.oriented_form: Replace form filter bank with Gaussian sigma=1 (5x5) then signed Sobel x/y/magnitude after existing hex and local adaptation; processed colour unchanged.
candidates.linear_colour: Rectify hex-smoothed raw G-B difference without pre-opponent tanh; form unchanged.
candidates.balanced_linear: Predefined combination of balanced_form and linear_colour.
